editions.source: Clarim Diário sáb 07/11 — disparo avulso pedido pelo Hadukem (10:53) porque a mesa não entregou nada de manhã. Ronda avulsa dos 3 repórteres às 10:57-11:03 (Gleison, Bruno, Mathias). Beats deles vieram secos: nenhum post de parceiro/MAG7/xStocks fora da Mantle dentro da janela de 12h. Completei a edição com varredura própria no @WatcherGuru via xread (11:13Z) e conferi os dois links abrindo cada URL (texto, hora UTC e engajamento no mesmo minuto).

posts.text: JUST IN: 🇺🇸🇨🇳 US reportedly approved Nvidia $NVDA chip sales to Chinese firms with empty offices and suspicious ties.
posts.pt: EUA teriam aprovado venda de chips da Nvidia para empresas chinesas com escritórios vazios e vínculos suspeitos. NVDA é o ticker mais quente do fim de semana.

options.a: approved to sell chips to firms whose offices are empty. the office was the product
options.b: headline lands on a saturday. the ticker sits still until monday. that gap is the whole argument for a market that never closes
options.c: approving the sale and checking the buyer are two different jobs. only one of them got done before the ink dried

posts.text: JUST IN: 🇺🇸🇨🇳 US intelligence finds Nvidia $NVDA CEO Jensen Huang had a 'romantic relationship' with a Chinese spy, FT reports.
posts.pt: FT: inteligência dos EUA aponta relacionamento do CEO da Nvidia com uma espiã chinesa. 13,8 mil likes, maior engajamento do dia no X de mercado.

options.a: two huangs don't make a right. the replies are funnier than the story
options.b: a story like this breaks at 3am. monday's open is 53 hours away. onchain, nobody waits for a bell to price news
options.c: the relationship is the headline, the clearance is the story. nobody asking who signed off on the chips

own_post_options.A: mantle dex volume: $15m to $28m in one week. +87%, no announcement, no thread. liquidity is quieter than headlines and it compounds.
own_post_options.B: a headline at 3am, a market that opens on monday. the difference between those two clocks is the entire product.
